definitions.explanation: Good for one's health, or looking healthy; also, by extension, sound and wholesome in character.

examples.japanese: {健康的|けんこうてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日焼|ひや}けして→日焼けする：20314_hiyakesuru⟧{健康的|けんこうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。

⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{健康的|けんこうてき}な⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧ようになって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{体重|たいじゅう}→体重：03395_taijuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: Since I started trying to eat healthy, vegetable-based meals, I've lost weight.

notes:
⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ (health) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (-like). ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧な describes a person who is in good health; {健康的|けんこうてき}な describes what is good for health (food, habits) or what looks healthy (a tan, a figure).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {健康的|けんこうてき}な⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧: a healthy diet
- {健康的|けんこうてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: a healthy lifestyle
- {健康的|けんこうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{痩|や}せる→痩せる：01146_yaseru⟧: to lose weight in a healthy way
- {健康的|けんこうてき}な⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: healthy-looking skin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧な: healthy; of a person's condition (⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧な⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧)
- ヘルシー: healthy; used mostly of food that is light and low in calories
